items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar end date for the ordinary termination of the lease: 28.02.2027. No period calculation is needed since the date is given directly.

items.title: Tenant's objection (Widerspruch) to termination must reach landlord
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens am 31.12.2026 zugehen.
items.computation: The letter fixes an explicit calendar deadline for the tenant's objection under §§ 574–574b BGB: it must reach (zugehen) the landlord by 31.12.2026 at the latest. 31.12.2026 falls on a Thursday and is not a Sunday or statutory public holiday in NRW (Silvester is not a legal holiday), so no shift under § 193 BGB is required; the stated date stands as the final day.
